$description: Sidekick design tokens. W3C Design Tokens Community Group format (2025.10). Light is the default theme; theme.dark holds the dark values.

amber.$description: Gradient start, from the icon background (top left).

orange.$description: Midpoint of the brand gradient. Use for a single solid brand accent, such as the Slack message bar.

coral.$description: Gradient end, from the icon background (bottom right).

gradient.$description: Brand moments only: header strip, login, the one main call to action, the character tile. Never for data, charts or status.

real.$description: Real issue. Icon: lucide 'siren'. Slack emoji: :rotating_light:. Slack bar: #C4261C.

false.$description: False alarm. Icon: lucide 'bell-off'. Slack emoji: :no_bell:. Slack bar: #1F8A4C.

unsure.$description: Not sure yet. Icon: lucide 'circle-help'. Slack emoji: :grey_question:. Slack bar: #7C85A3.

duplicate.$description: Duplicate. Icon: lucide 'link'. Slack emoji: :link:. Slack bar: #2C57CD.

known.$description: Known issue. Icon: lucide 'pin'. Slack emoji: :pushpin:. Slack bar: #2C57CD. Shares the Duplicate colors.

flapping.$description: Flapping. Icon: lucide 'repeat'. Slack emoji: :repeat:. Slack bar: #17998D.
